subject: Orestone security review + procurement sync
messages:
From: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@orestone.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orestone.com>, procurement@orestone.com
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: security review and evidence session (Orestone)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the performance numbers. Our security and procurement teams have asked for a focused security review and evidence session before we can move forward with a pilot.

Attendees from our side: Samir Khan (Infra), procurement@orestone.com (procurement lead). Goal: 60-75 minute session to walk through architecture, data flows, retention, and the SOC-2 related evidence.

Could you please propose 2-3 slots next week (Nov 8–12) that include a Redwood security/compliance engineer and an SE who can speak to deployment/topology? I attached our initial questionnaire and a basic network diagram.

Attachments: orestone-security-questionnaire-2026.pdf, network-diagram-v3.png

Thanks,
Alex Gonzalez
Principal Engineer, Orestone
alex.gonzalez@orestone.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@orestone.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review and evidence session (Orestone)

Hi Alex — appreciate the clear ask and the questionnaire, that helps a lot.

Proposed slots (all in PST):
- Tue Nov 9, 10:00–11:15am
- Wed Nov 10, 2:00–3:15pm
- Thu Nov 11, 9:00–10:15am

Marissa (security) and Aditya (SE) are looped in — Aditya can cover topology/deployment, Marissa will cover compliance evidence and retention policies. If any slot works, we can send a calendar invite and a short pre-read from our side.

We can also split into two back-to-back meetings if procurement needs a separate procurement/contracting conversation.

Thanks — I’ll hold the Tue and Wed slots tentatively until I hear back.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@orestone.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orestone.com>, procurement@orestone.com
Date: 2026-11-05T12:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review and evidence session (Orestone)

Thanks Irene — Wed Nov 10 2pm PST works best for our engineers. Procurement (procurement@orestone.com) is asking if we can do a short 30-minute procurement kickoff either immediately before or after that slot (they prefer before). Samir and I can stay for both.

If you can also share the pre-read and any evidence artifacts we should expect, that would speed things up.

Also: can the security session note whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS and what logs are available for audit? That’s a high-priority ask from our info security lead.

Alex
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@orestone.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Calendar hold + pre-read items

Hey Alex — thanks, Wed Nov 10 2pm PST is confirmed on my calendar. I created a calendar event and added a 30-minute procurement pre-brief at 1:30pm PST (separate invite) so procurement can do the kickoff you suggested.

Pre-reads we’ll share by EOD Tue Nov 9:
- Redwood security brief (high level SOC2 scope, retention, KMS options)
- Evidence inventory (what we can share post-NDA)
- Operational logging summary (what’s in audit logs + retention defaults)

Quick technical questions so we can tailor the session:
1) Are you planning hosted Redwood API (hosted) or a Private/VPC deployment for the pilot?
2) Expected retention window for logs/requests (default vs required)?
3) Any specific compliance requirements beyond SOC2 (e.g. HIPAA or PCI)?

If you can reply with quick answers to the above, we’ll prepare focused slides.

— Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@orestone.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review and evidence session (Orestone)

Thanks team — adding a couple of notes from security/compliance perspective before Wed: 

1) Pre-read attached: redwood-security-brief-v2.pdf — includes KMS options (customer-managed KMS via cloud KMS is supported for Private and Dedicated; hosted customers can use Bring Your Own Key with partner KMS in some regions), audit log types, and evidence we can reasonably provide.
2) Evidence: we can share SOC 2 Type II summary report highlights and redacted control evidence on an access-controlled drive. Full reports require an NDA or an executed DPA depending on your legal rules.
3) For the session, please have your network/infra engineer on the call (Samir is good) so we can walk the network diagram you provided.

I also requested the following artifacts be ready on our side for the call: a short list of sample audit logs, configuration screenshots, and a diagram showing KV cache/data flow for the inference runtime (I’ll bring the runtime diagram).

If procurement needs contract-level terms we can slot 30 minutes before as Aditya suggested. Otherwise we can keep the meeting to the 75-minute security readout.

— Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@orestone.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orestone.com>, procurement@orestone.com
Date: 2026-11-07T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review and evidence session (Orestone)

Perfect — confirmed for Wed Nov 10 2:00pm PST (procurement pre-brief 1:30pm). I accepted the invites and uploaded the completed questionnaire to the shared drive: https://drive.orestone.com/teams/infra/redwood-pre-reads (please confirm you can access).

Quick answers to Aditya’s questions:
- Deployment: initially hosted Redwood API (we’ll evaluate Dedicated later).
- Retention: default dev logs for 30 days, security wants 90 days of request-level logs for pilot.
- Compliance: SOC2 only for now (no HIPAA/PCI).

Samir and I will be on both invites. Thanks for moving quickly. Looking forward to the session — if anything changes I’ll update the thread.

Alex
Principal Engineer, Orestone
alex.gonzalez@orestone.com
